translations.web: “In that day there will be a spring opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.
translations.bsb: “On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the people of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.
